titles.title: Door Through Window

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: In this abstract piece, the view of an exterior door and wall is fragmented by a window with several panes.  The door is black, while the wall is rendered in several shades of brown.  A fragmented sky fills the upper left corner of the work.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
